body: P1-3 needs one normative D4b bullet after the current P0-1 ADR holder releases it: segment d_chart/d_wl = Minimum over observed compatible chart-pair estimates after ContradictionDetector membership; source-chart coverage, compatible estimate coverage, excluded members, and member estimates are separate receipt fields; no neutral imputation. The bead is phrased against ADR 0001 D4b but does not explicitly list the ADR path. May I reserve/edit that one paragraph after P0-1 lands, or should the accepted board decision remain the only design record for this slice? I will not touch the current reservation.
